pivots.stem: What does the professor say the instruments in the Danholt Trough recorded about the deep current?
settings: It ran strongest in the winter months and slackened through each summer
It reversed direction for several weeks in each year of the record

pivots.stem: Why does the professor mention the logbooks kept by the local fishing crews?

pivots.stem: What will the research team most likely do next?

pivots.stem: According to the professor, what happened to the notebooks after Dole's death?
